plugins.readme_text:
# 📦 @goodandready/dsh-opencode-provider

OpenCode Console & OpenCode Go LLM Provider for DeepSeek Harness

⭐ If you like this plugin, please star it on GitHub — it shows me that the plugin is useful to you and motivates me to keep developing it.

🐛 If you find a bug or would like to request a feature, open a GitHub issue in any language — I will review your proposal and implement useful suggestions in a future plugin version.
--- OpenCode / OpenCode Go provider plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/) (dsh). It registers two native LLM routes: | Route | Product | Base | |---|---|---| | `opencode-direct` | OpenCode Console / Zen (pay-as-you-go) | `https://opencode.ai/inference` | | `opencode-go-direct` | OpenCode Go / Go Plus subscription | `https://opencode.ai/inference/go` | Requests resolve the key per call, so a changed credential reaches the next request without a restart. The ids use the `-direct` suffix because the built-in `llm-pi-ai` catalog already owns `opencode` and `opencode-go`. Reusing those ids makes the core registry reject the duplicate (`DUPLICATE_DIRECTORY`) and drop the built-in catalog, which hides the other providers and disables the add button. Existing sessions recorded under the old ids stay on the built-in routes; select **OpenCode (plugin)** or **OpenCode Go (plugin)** for this plugin's accounts, quotas, fallback and telemetry. ## Architecture ```mermaid graph LR subgraph DSH["DeepSeek Harness Core"] Agent["DSH Agent / Chat"] Creds["Credentials / auth.json"] end subgraph Plugin["dsh-opencode-provider"] Router{"Route Selector"} Pool["Multi-Account Pool
(Auto-Rotation & Cooldowns)"] Heatmap["Heatmap & Quota Telemetry
(5h / Week / Month)"] subgraph Transports["4 Wire Transports"] T1["OpenAI Chat"] T2["Anthropic Messages
(Thinking Signatures)"] T3["OpenAI Responses"] T4["Google GenAI
(thoughtSignature Replay)"] end end subgraph OpenCode["OpenCode Gateway"] Console["opencode-direct (Console / Zen)"] Go["opencode-go-direct (Go / Go Plus)"] end Agent --> Router Creds -.-> Pool Router -->|opencode-direct| Pool Router -->|opencode-go-direct| Pool Pool --> Heatmap Pool --> Transports T1 & T2 & T3 & T4 --> Console & Go ``` ## What works - **Four wire transports**, chosen per model: - OpenAI Chat Completions (DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, MiMo, LongCat, Hy3, Step, …). - Anthropic Messages (Claude Haiku, MiniMax, Qwen). - OpenAI Responses (GPT, Grok, Muse). - Google Generative AI (Gemini). - **Text, reasoning, streamed tool calls, usage, finish reasons.** - **Images** through the durable attachment service, rendered natively per transport; **file attachments** are projected to DSH's deterministic handle text (the harness supplies the read-only execution path), never inline bytes. - **Tool-result images** are inlined by Anthropic, OpenAI Responses and Google; OpenAI Chat keeps the text placeholder because its tool message has no image part. - **Replay of provider metadata** where the endpoint requires it: - Anthropic thinking signatures. - Gemini `thoughtSignature` on historical function calls. - **Multi-account rotation** before a stream starts: 401/403/429 and quota/usage-limit bodies (400/402/403/429). An invalid key cools down for 24h, a quota rejection for 10 minutes or `Retry-After`, a rate limit for 60s or `Retry-After`. A request already streaming is never replayed on another account; the next request uses the next usable key. - **Per-account quotas**: each account row shows its own 5-hour / weekly / monthly usage, the active account drives the sidebar and quota panel, and the panel lists every account side by side. - **Per-account runway**: estimates time to exhaustion from the average burn rate of each window and marks the first window projected to run out before its reset; approximate because the API exposes only the current percentage and reset time. - **Model → account rules**: first matching glob pins a preferred account for that model; the other accounts remain fallbacks if it fails or is cooling. - **Request heatmap** in the quota panel: a Monday-first weekday × hour grid in local time, plus a 24-hour aggregate strip underneath. Selectors switch between all requests, any single model, and any single account. A per-account table shows requests, errors and average latency/TTFT. The adapter appends `{at, provider, model, purpose?, account, reason, ok, latencyMs, ttftMs?, error?}` to `~/.dsh/storages/dsh-opencode/requests.jsonl`; no prompt, response or key is stored. Auxiliary `session-title`/`compaction` calls are excluded from the heatmap and exact duplicate records collapse. The log compacts at 2 MB to the newest 5000 lines. Collection starts with this build — the projection cache only has `lastPromptAt`, not per-request timestamps. - **Stable `x-opencode-session`** derived from the durable session id, so retries and every turn of a conversation reuse the same routing key. - **Live catalog** from `/v1/models` with a generated `models.dev` fallback. - **Per-model subscription limits** from the OpenCode Go pricing table: monthly dollar allowance plus estimated requests for the 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows, for both Go and Go Plus. Shown in the model picker and the settings page; estimates only — the gateway remains the authority. - **`/opencode` command** for status, usage, accounts, models, rules, and `test [model]`. - **TUI settings section** for the terminal profile (`/settings → OpenCode`) with the key, endpoints, allowlist, active account, fallback model, sticky routing and timeouts. - **Quota fallback**: choose a free model in Settings → OpenCode; a Go quota rejection retries once through Console/Zen. - **Sticky account**: the last successful account is preferred for the same conversation and survives restarts via a local `sticky.json` (hashed session ids and key fingerprints only); explicit model rules and pinned accounts win. - **Routing trace** in the quota panel and per-account heatmap filter. - **One-click plugin update** in Settings → OpenCode: current/latest version, an update badge, and an **Update now** button that installs the exact npm version through the DSH CLI and asks for a restart. The host endpoint is `GET/POST /dsh-opencode/update`. - **Plan-aware Go picker**: hides models outside the Go table unless turned off; descriptions carry `Go`, `Console` or `FREE`. - **Request-wide image budget** (newest images win, oldest become an omitted placeholder) and **object-root tool-schema normalization** for MCP/third-party tools. - **Usage analytics dashboard** in the quota panel: KPI cards (requests, tokens, success, input/output, reasoning, cache, TTFT, latency, errors), a 7/30/90 selector, and Models / Days / Sessions tables. Success and error cards show `—`: the local projection does not expose failed attempts or reasoning tokens. - **Usage by model** from the local session projection cache: sessions and tokens per OpenCode model. Only numeric metadata is read; titles and message content stay local. - **Browser UI**: - **Settings → OpenCode**: key status, paste/import/clear, quota bars, accounts, model allowlist, per-model transport overrides, connection settings. -

plugins.description: 给 DSH Web 侧栏腾点地方。 Too many DSH plugins, too little room.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-toomuch-plugins **Makes room in the DSH Web sidebar.** · *Too many plugins, too little room.* [![license](https://img.shields.io/github/license/rivenshanghai/dsh-toomuch-plugins)](https://github.com/rivenshanghai/dsh-toomuch-plugins/blob/main/LICENSE) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-toomuch-plugins)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-toomuch-plugins) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-blue)](https://github.com/rivenshanghai/dsh-toomuch-plugins) [![topic](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-8A2BE2)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) [English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
--- A small plugin set that gives the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) Web sidebar some breathing room. It ships one plugin today: | Plugin | What it does | | --- | --- | | Sidebar panel collapse | Collapses the "global panels" column above the workspace into one toggle in the sidebar footer | ## Why The DSH Web sidebar stacks, from top to bottom: brand row → new session → **global panel entries** → workspace → settings. Every plugin that adds a sidebar entry adds a row to that column: plugins, plugin market, schedules, MCP studio, context, skill manager, system monitor… Seven rows are roughly 280px, which squeezes the workspace region down to a few sessions. This plugin does exactly one thing: **collapse that column of global panel entries**, and bring it back when you need it. ## Highlights - **Collapsed by default** — the workspace gets ~280px back as soon as the plugin is installed. - **One toggle** in the sidebar footer, right above "settings". - **Remembered** in `localStorage`; survives reloads and restarts. - **Nothing else is touched** — no panel, no workspace, no host behaviour; only the display of the list element the sidebar already renders. - **Themed** with `--dsw-alias-*` tokens only, so it follows the DSH theme. - **Rail-friendly** — in the narrow 56px rail the toggle becomes a round icon button. ## Install The plugin is a repository-root package: it declares the `dsh.bundle` manifest, so DSH can install it straight from npm or GitHub. ```sh # from npm (prebuilt — no build approval step) dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-toomuch-plugins # from GitHub dsh plugin --profile web add github:rivenshanghai/dsh-toomuch-plugins # or from a local clone git clone https://github.com/rivenshanghai/dsh-toomuch-plugins.git dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-toomuch-plugins ``` `dsh plugin` forwards to `pnpm` inside the profile. After the install, **enable the plugin** in DSH's plugin settings (it is written into the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`), then refresh the page. From the plugin market, once listed: open **Settings → Plugin Market** in DSH and search for `dsh-toomuch-plugins`. **Verify:** the sidebar footer gains a "Collapse global panels / Expand global panels" row above "settings", and the global panel column is gone. Requirements: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) with a `web` profile; Node.js ≥ 20. ## How it works `src/client.js` does three things: 1. registers a toggle into the sidebar footer slot `sidebar.footer.action` (the row next to "settings"); 2. walks up from its own root node to find the sidebar root's direct `
` child — the global panel list — and toggles its `display`; 3. remembers the choice in `localStorage`. The basis is DSH's own `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar`: `nav.panelList` is a direct child of the sidebar root, so walking up from the footer button always reaches it. Styling uses only `--dsw-alias-*` theme variables, and the stylesheet rides inside the component, so unmounting removes it. No DSH internal package is imported, and no DSH file is modified. The full contract is written down in [docs/design.md](docs/design.md). ## Repository layout ``` . ├── package.json plugin manifest: dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client ├── cordis.patch.yml inserts the loader row into the profile ├── src/ │ ├── index.js Host half (no host capabilities needed; apply is empty) │ └── client.js Client half: footer toggle + collapse/expand logic ├── locale/{en,zh}.json title and description in the plugin list ├── docs/ design notes, market submission, pre-submit checklist ├── icon.svg icon ├── CHANGELOG.md └── LICENSE ``` ## Known limits - It collapses the **global panel entries** column only. The brand row, new session and settings are left alone — the brand row's "collapse sidebar" button is the only entry point on Linux / Windows, so hiding it would lose a feature. - With no global panels installed, the sidebar never renders that `
` and the toggle is a harmless no-op. - Verified on DSH Web (Linux) only. ## Plugin market DSH plugins are listed in the [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) catalog, which aggregates the repositories carrying the **`dsh-plugin`** GitHub topic. Add that topic to this repository, then open a one-file pull request against that catalog: the entry file is `data/plugins/__.yml`, with a `category`, a one-line `description.en` and an optional `description.zh` (the catalog's contributing guide has the exact rules). ## Related plugins - [dsh-sidebar-quiet](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-sidebar-quiet) — folds the sidebar **footer** rows (balance / import / memory / sign out) into one line - [dsh-sidebar-buttons](https://github.com/lywusichen/dsh-sidebar-buttons) — manage sidebar footer buttons: drag to reorder, show / fold into More / hide - [dsh-sidebar-pins](https://github.com/AndreyTepaykin/dsh-sidebar-pins) — a collapsible pinned-sessions block above the settings row - [dsh-sidebar-drawer](https://github.com/1dustycy/dsh-sidebar-drawer) — an edge-hover drawer that expands the sidebar - [dsh-plugin-sidebar-visibility](https://github.com/Robert-Wang-08/dsh-plugin-sidebar-visibility) — hide / collapse at the workspace level ## Contributing Bug reports and pull requests are welcome. Please include your DSH version, the browser, and whether the toggle appeared in the sidebar footer. Keep the change focused: this plugin does one thing, and the DOM contract it relies on is documented in [docs/design.md](docs/design.md). ## License MIT © [rivenshanghai](https://github.com/rivenshanghai) — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.description: wraps microsoft/playwright-cli
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-playwright-cli

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-playwright-cli)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-playwright-cli)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-playwright-cli)](LICENSE)

Drive a real browser from **DeepSeek Harness**: one tool, `playwright_cli`, wraps
[`microsoft/playwright-cli`](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright-cli), plus a bundled
`playwright-cli` skill that teaches the model the command vocabulary.

playwright-cli itself recommends *CLI + skills* over MCP for coding agents: commands are short, and
the page snapshot goes to a file instead of a giant tool schema or accessibility tree. This plugin
keeps that design and only adds the two missing pieces — a tool the model can call, and a skill that
is discovered and loaded on demand.

中文说明见 [README.zh.md](README.zh.md)。

## Install

**In the app:** **Plugins → Plugin Manager → install bundle → `dsh-playwright-cli`**.

**From a shell**, when the Harness CLI is on your PATH:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add dsh-playwright-cli
```

**From an agent:** `plugin_manager` with `action: install_bundle`, `target: dsh-playwright-cli`.

> PATH collisions are common on Windows (`dsh` may belong to another product). If `dsh plugin` is not
> the Harness CLI, use the in-app Plugin Manager.

`playwright-cli` must be available on the machine:

```bash
npm install -g @playwright/cli@latest
```

And a browser has to exist — playwright-cli ships none. Either download its Chromium once:

```bash
playwright-cli install-browser chrome-for-testing
```

or reuse a browser that is already installed, which needs no download at all:

```text
playwright_cli  open https://example.com --browser=msedge
```

## Quick start

```text
playwright_cli  open https://playwright.dev --browser=msedge
playwright_cli  snapshot --depth=4
   → [artifacts] C:\...\.playwright-cli\page-....yml   (read this file to get refs)
playwright_cli  click e15
playwright_cli  fill e7 "user@example.com"
playwright_cli  screenshot --filename=shot.png
playwright_cli  close
```

Every result carries the page status, the artifacts it produced (absolute paths), and the CLI's exit
code. `--raw` returns just the value, e.g. `--raw eval "document.title"`.

## Tool parameters

| Parameter | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `command` | yes | One playwright-cli command without the `playwright-cli` prefix. Quote arguments containing spaces. |
| `session` | no | Named browser session (`-s=<name>`), for isolating parallel tasks. |
| `workdir` | no | Working directory; artifacts land in `<workdir>/.playwright-cli/`. Defaults to the session directory. |
| `timeoutMs` | no | Per-call wall clock limit (default from config, capped at 900000). |

## Configuration

Every field is optional and lives in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` under the `playwright-cli` row:

| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `executable` | auto-discovered | Absolute path to `playwright-cli.js` (run with `nodePath`) or to a real executable |
| `nodePath` | `node` from PATH | Node used for the CLI *and* the browser daemon it spawns |
| `session` | none | Default session name |
| `timeoutMs` | `120000` | Per-command limit |
| `disableUpdateNotifier` | `true` | Sets `NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER=1` (see the Node 24 note below) |
| `env` | `{}` | Extra environment, e.g. `PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_BROWSER: chrome` |

## How it works

- **No shell.** The command line is tokenized and passed as an argv vector to
  `node playwright-cli.js …`, so `&` in URLs, spaces in paths, `--data="k=v"` and Windows quoting
  cannot corrupt a command.
- **Discovery.** It walks up from the session directory looking for a local
  `node_modules/@playwright/cli` or `node_modules/playwright`, then checks the usual global npm,
  pnpm and Homebrew locations. `executable` overrides all of it.
- **Real Node, not the Host binary.** The desktop Host runs as Electron-as-node
  (`ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1`), so `process.execPath` is the app binary. playwright-cli re-spawns its
  browser daemon with that path and dies with `too many arguments`; the plugin therefore resolves a
  real `node` from PATH first.
- **Exit codes are honest.** playwright-cli's update notifier crashes the process *after* a successful
  command on Node 24 (exit code becomes `0xC0000409`); the notifier is disabled by default.
- **Artifacts are files.** Snapshots, screenshots, PDFs, videos, traces and console logs are resolved
  to absolute paths and listed under `[artifacts]`, so the model reads them with `read` / `read_image`
  instead of paying for them in the result.
- **Hints, not guesses.** The two first-run failures (no browser installed, browser not started) get
  an extra `[hint]` line with the exact next command.

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `playwright-cli is not installed or was not found` | no local/global install | `npm i -g @playwright/cli@latest`, or set `executable` |
| `Browser "chrome-for-testing" is not installed` | no bundled browser | `playwright_cli install-browser chrome-for-testing`, or `--browser=msedge` |
| `Chromium distribution 'chrome' is not found` | Chrome not in its default path | `--browser=msedge` or `--browser=chrome` |
| `too many arguments. Expected 1 argument but got 2` | CLI launched with the Electron binary | leave `nodePath` unset so the plugin resolves `node` |
| `The browser '<name>' is not open` | session idle-closed or never opened | `open` again (add `--persistent` to keep the profile) |
| `百度安全验证` page on Baidu | site-level anti-automation captcha | not a plugin bug: report the wall, try another engine |
| snapshot only has header/footer | results rendered after the command returned | re-run `snapshot`, or use `find "<text>"` |

## Maintaining this plugin

### Repository layout

| Path | Owns | Update it when |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `index.js` | Tool schema, spawn, discovery, artifacts, hints, presenters | CLI flags/output shape change, or DSH's `ToolDefinition` changes |
| `skill.js` | Model-facing skill text (command table, loop, triage) | the command surface changes |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Loader row + default config + field comments | you add a config key |
| `locale/*.json`, `icon.svg` | Plugin Manager title, description, icon | wording/branding |
| `README.md`, `README.zh.md` | user + maintainer docs | any behavior change |

### Adapting to a new playwright-cli release

1. `npm view @playwright/cli version`, then `npm i -g @playwright/cli@latest`.
2. `playwright-cli --help` — compare the command list with the table in `skill.js`. The skill *is* the
   model's contract, so keep it in sync before anything else.
3. Check `open` / `attach` flags (`--browser`, `--device`, `--persistent`, `--profile`, `--config`).
   New flags normally need docs only, no code.
4. Check the output markers: `### Page`, `### Snapshot`, `[Snapshot](.playwright-cli/…)`, `### Events`
   with `console-….log#L1-L6`. If a path shape changes, adjust `MARKDOWN_LINK`, `FILE_TOKEN` and the
   `#L…` stripping in `collectArtifacts()`.
5. Check session selection: the plugin passes `-s=<name>` **and** sets `PLAYWRIGHT_CLI_SESSION`. If a
   release starts rejecting one of them, drop the env assignment in `execute()`.
6. Check the error strings matched by `hintFor()`: `is not installed`,
   `Chromium distribution 'chrome' is not found`, `is not open, please run open first`.
7. Run the smoke test below, then bump the version and the changelog.

### The output schema is enforced

DSH validates the tool's returned value against `output.schema`; a mismatch fails the whole call with
`returned invalid output`. Declare every nullable field as
`oneOf: [{type:'string'}, {type:'null'}]` (this bit us once with `signal: null`), and build the
returned object and the schema together.

### Adapting to a new DSH release

1. `dsh --version`; only raise `engines.dsh` when you depend on something new.
2. Re-check the four services the plugin uses. In a live session: `cordis_inspect_query` with
   `platform: host`, `provider: Service`, `input: {"service":"tools"}` (also `subprocess`, `skills`,
   `workingDirectory`).
3. Confirm `ctx.subprocess.resolveExecutable('node')` s

plugins.description: Ink-wash whale-leap splash for the DeepSeek Harness web UI.
plugins.readme_text:
# Ink Whale Leap · 水墨鲸跃

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that plays a short ink-wash whale-leap animation over the web UI when the page loads, then fades out by itself.

![Ink Whale Leap](assets/launch.png)

[中文说明](README.zh.md)

## What it shows

A full-window overlay in the palette of an ink wash on paper: the whale rises out of the still water, three ink rings spread from the waterline, a few ink drops scatter upward, and the wordmark `DeepSeek Harness` settles in with a red `鲸` seal and the line `鲸跃 · 与你同游`.

- 3.95 s after the page loads the overlay fades, and it is removed from the DOM at 4.75 s.
- `Esc` dismisses it immediately.
- With `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` the animations are turned off.
- If the tab is hidden when the page loads, playback waits for the tab to become visible (15 s fallback).
- The overlay is decorative: `aria-hidden="true"`, `pointer-events: none`, so it never takes clicks or keyboard focus.

![Ink rings spreading from the waterline](assets/rings.png)

## Install

Once the plugin is listed in the DSH plugin market, install it from Settings → Plugins. From a command line:

```
dsh plugin add dsh-ink-whale-leap
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so installing it adds one loader row — there is no client bundle to approve.

## Preview without installing

Open `preview.html` in a browser from a checkout of this repository; it loads `splash.js` against a blank page.

## How it works

This is a host-only plugin. It reacts to `webserver/index-inject` by pushing a single inline `<script>` row, and serves the animation source at `/ink-whale/splash.js` from the `webServer` service.

There is deliberately no client entry point: in DSH, a client bundle that fails to activate aborts the web boot, and a launch animation is not worth that risk. Every step of activation is wrapped in `try/catch`, so a missing service or a failing injection leaves the app untouched instead of breaking it.

The animation itself is one self-contained IIFE with inline CSS and SVG (`splash.js`) — no network requests, no fonts, no images.

## Configuration

None. The plugin has no settings page and no options.

## Uninstall

Remove it the same way as any other plugin (market uninstall, or `dsh plugin remove dsh-ink-whale-leap`).

## Notes

- The animation runs once per page load, on every window that loads the web UI — it is not a once-per-install welcome screen.
- It only paints over the web UI; the desktop window chrome is unaffected.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: 两级搜索 failover 插件（Tavily → DeepSeek Search API；Fetch: DeepSeek → 直连）。带额度感知熔断，第一层失败自动切第二层。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-fk-search-tier

**两级搜索 + 两级抓取 failover** —— 搜索先 Tavily 后 DeepSeek Search API；抓取先 DeepSeek Fetch API 后直连兜底。

> DeepSeek Harness 插件。不改 DSH 本体，纯 `ctx.web` provider 注册。

---

## 为什么做这个

DSH 默认的 `deepseek-official` 搜索通道：

- 每次搜索**消耗一个完整模型轮次**（实测约 9.6K input token）
- 按 token 计费，高峰期成本翻倍

两级方案把成本压到最低：

```
【搜索】searchProvider: search-tier
第 1 层  Tavily   → 免 key 匿名档 / 免费 1000 credits/月
                    ↓  429 / 额度耗尽 / 5xx / 超时 / 空结果
第 2 层  DeepSeek → 5 元 / 1000 次成功请求（按次，不烧 token）

【抓取】fetchProvider: fetch-tier
第 1 层  DeepSeek Fetch API → 返回干净 Markdown（实测 ~0.3 秒）
                    ↓  429 / 额度耗尽 / 5xx / 超时
第 2 层  直连抓取           → 零成本兜底（HTML → 纯文本）
```

**实测数据**（2026-10-17）：

| 项目 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| Tavily keyless 免注册 | ✅ 返回 5 条真实结果 |
| DeepSeek Fetch API | ✅ 0.53s / 931 字符（example.com） |
| DeepSeek Fetch 真实页面 | ✅ 0.27s / 24,740 字符（GitHub 仓库页） |
| 不存在的域名 | HTTP 500（API 的预期行为，触发切层） |

---

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add <本包路径或包名>
```

⚠️ **必须让 DSH 走 bundle 机制自动加载 patch**，不要手工把 `cordis.patch.yml`
的内容抄进 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` —— 那会绕过加载时序，导致
`tool-web: waiting for web`。

装完重启 DSH。

---

## 配置

### ⚠️ 先把这件事说清楚：密钥不要写进插件目录

插件目录里的 `cordis.patch.yml` 是**随插件发布**的文件。
把 `apiKey` 写在那里，等于把密钥公开（推 GitHub、发给别人、打包分发都会带上）。

**正确做法有两种，任选其一（推荐 A）：**

---

### A. 用环境变量（推荐）

插件会自动读这两个环境变量，`cordis.patch.yml` 里留空即可：

| 后端 | 环境变量 |
|---|---|
| DeepSeek Search / Fetch | `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` |
| Tavily（可选） | `TAVILY_API_KEY` |

**Windows — PowerShell（当前用户，永久生效）：**

```powershell
[Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable("DEEPSEEK_API_KEY", "sk-你的key", "User")
```

**Windows — 图形界面：**

```
Win + R  →  sysdm.cpl  →  高级  →  环境变量
  → 用户变量 → 新建 → 变量名 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY，变量值填你的 key
  → 确定 → 重启 DSH
```

> 改完环境变量**必须重启 DSH** 才生效 —— 已在运行的进程不会重新读取。

---

### B. 在 profile 层覆盖（密钥放私有文件）

`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` 是**你自己的私有文件**，不随插件发布。

在文件末尾追加：

```yaml
# 覆盖 search-tier 的配置（本文件是私有的，可以写密钥）
- id: search-tier
  name: dsh-fk-search-tier
  config:
    order: [tavily, deepseek]

    deepseek:
      apiKey: 'sk-你的key'
      baseURL: https://api.deepseek.com

    tavily:
      apiKey: 'tvly-你的key'   # 可选；没有就走 keyless 匿名档
```

**注意**：profile 层的同名 id 会**整段覆盖**插件自带的配置，
所以「想保留的键都要重述一遍」，不能只写 `apiKey`。

---

### 最小配置（零配置也能用）

**不配任何密钥**也能工作：

- **Search**：Tavily 的 keyless 匿名档（免注册，实测可用）
- **Fetch**：直连抓取（零成本兜底）

```yaml
- id: search-tier
  name: dsh-fk-search-tier
  config:
    order: [tavily, deepseek]
    tavily: {}
    deepseek: {}          # 无 key → 该层自动跳过
```

**代价**：没有 DeepSeek 层作为兜底，Tavily 匿名档限流时就没有第二层了。

---

### 完整配置项

```yaml
- id: search-tier
  name: dsh-fk-search-tier
  config:
    # ── 层级顺序 ──
    order: [tavily, deepseek]              # 搜索：先 Tavily，再 DeepSeek
    fetchOrder: [deepseek-fetch, direct]   # 抓取：先 DeepSeek Fetch，再直连

    # ── 第 1 层：Tavily ──
    tavily:
      # apiKey 留空 → keyless 匿名档；有 key 走账户额度（1000 credits/月）
      depth: basic          # basic=1 credit | advanced=2 credits
      maxResults: 8

    # ── DeepSeek 官方 API（Search + Fetch）──
    deepseek:
      # apiKey 留空 → 自动读环境变量 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY；仍然没有 → 该层跳过
      baseURL: https://api.deepseek.com
      maxResults: 8
      needContent: false     # true 会额外返回网页正文（更慢、更长）
      fetchMaxBytes: 200000  # Fetch 单页最大字节

    # ── 直连抓取（零成本兜底）──
    direct:
      # userAgent: ''        # 可覆盖默认 UA
      {}

    # ── 超时 ──
    timeoutMs: 20000         # 搜索单层超时
    fetchTimeoutMs: 30000    # 抓取单层超时（页面通常更大）
    failOnEmpty: true        # 上一层返回 0 条也切下一层

    # ── 熔断 ──
    breaker:
      threshold: 3           # 瞬时故障累计几次才开断
      burstWindowMs: 300000  # 5 分钟窗口
      cooldownMs: 60000      # 瞬时故障冷却 60 秒
      quotaCooldownMs: 3600000  # 额度耗尽冷却 1 小时
```

---

### 怎么确认密钥读到了

配好并重启 DSH 后，让 AI 调一次诊断工具：

```
search_tier_status
```

返回的 `layers` 里看 `hasKey` 字段：

```json
{
  "id": "deepseek",
  "hasKey": true,        ← true 表示密钥读到了
  "needsKey": true,
  "open": false
}
```

**`hasKey: false` 说明密钥没读到**，按上面 A / B 检查，并确认已重启 DSH。

---

### 排查清单

| 现象 | 原因 | 解决 |
|---|---|---|
| `hasKey: false` | 环境变量没设，或设了没重启 DSH | 重设 + 重启 |
| `hasKey: true` 但报 401 | key 无效或已过期 | 去平台确认 |
| 一直用 Tavily，从不切 DeepSeek | Tavily 正常时不会切（这是设计） | 正常现象 |
| 两层都失败 | 网络问题 / 两边都额度耗尽 | 看错误信息里的 `skipped-open` |

---

## 切换规则

搜索与抓取共用同一套熔断语义（两个独立实例，参数相同）。

| 触发条件 | 行为 | 冷却 |
|---|---|---|
| `429` / `402` / 文本含 `insufficient` `quota` | 该层开断，立即切下一层 | **1 小时** |
| `401` / `403`（凭据问题） | 跳过该层（不冷却，配置改了立刻恢复） | 无 |
| `5xx` / 超时 / 网络错误 | 窗口内累计 3 次才开断 | **60 秒** |
| 返回 **0 条结果**（仅搜索） | 本次直接切下一层（不计入熔断） | 无 |
| 该层缺 key（仅 deepseek / deepseek-fetch） | 直接跳过 | 无 |

冷却到期后**自动半开**：下一次请求放行做探活，成功即闭合。

---

## 返回给模型的内容

### 搜索

严格遵循 DSH 的 `ctx.web` 契约，**只返回 `sources`**（让模型自己读）：

```js
{
  sources: [
    { url, title, snippet, publishedAt? }
  ],
  truncated: boolean,
  content?: string     // 仅 Tavily 返回 answer 时才带
}
```

- **Tavily**：`snippet` 取 `content` 前 500 字符
- **DeepSeek**：`snippet` 优先取 `summary`（600-800 字符长摘要），回退 `snippet`（100-200 字符）

模型收到的最终文本由 DSH 的 `formatSearchOutput` 组装成 markdown 来源列表。

### 抓取

按官方 `WebFetchResult` 契约：

```js
{
  url: string,              // 请求的 URL（API 不报告重定向后的最终 URL）
  statusCode: 200,          // 成功即 200（DeepSeek API 不报告目标页面状态）
  body: { kind: 'text', content: string },
  truncated: false
}
```

- **DeepSeek Fetch**：直接用 API 返回的 `content`（已是 Markdown）
- **直连抓取**：`fetch` 原始 HTML → `htmlToText()` 转纯文本；非 HTML 原样返回

---

## 诊断

注册了一个只读工具 `search_tier_status`，AI 可直接调用查看：

```json
{
  "search": {
    "providerId": "search-tier",
    "order": ["tavily", "deepseek"],
    "lastWinner": "tavily",
    "layers": [
      { "id": "tavily", "hasKey": false, "open": false, "lastError": null },
      { "id": "deepseek", "hasKey": true, "open": false, "lastError": null }
    ],
    "breaker": { "tavily": { "open": false, "remainingMs": 0 } }
  },
  "fetch": {
    "providerId": "fetch-tier",
    "order": ["deepseek-fetch", "direct"],
    "lastWinner": "deepseek-fetch",
    "layers": [
      { "id": "deepseek-fetch", "hasKey": true, "open": false, "lastError": null },
      { "id": "direct", "hasKey": true, "open": false, "lastError": null }
    ]
  }
}
```

---

## 自测

```sh
node test/selftest.mjs
```

**53 项断言**，覆盖：

| 段 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| 一 | 错误分类 `classify()` |
| 二 | 熔断器（额度 / 瞬时 / 半开） |
| 三 | 搜索 provider 契约 |
| 四 | **真实** Tavily keyless 调用 |
| 五 | 降级逻辑（熔断跳过） |
| 六 | 空结果切层 |
| 七 | **Fetch provider 契约与 failover**（13 项） |
| 八 | **真实** DeepSeek Fetch API 调用（5 项） |

---

## 与 dsh-search-failover 的区别

| | `dsh-search-failover` | **本插件** |
|---|---|---|
| 搜索后端数 | 10 个 | **2 个（专注）** |
| 抓取 failover | ❌ | ✅ **有（2 层）** |
| 支持 DeepSeek 新 Search API | ❌ 无 | ✅ **有** |
| 支持 DeepSeek Fetch API | ❌ 无 | ✅ **有** |
| Tavily keyless | ✅ | ✅ |
| 熔断 | ✅ | ✅ |
| 设置页 | ✅ | ❌（纯配置） |
| 代码量 | ~90 KB | **~26 KB** |

如果你的需求就是「Tavily → DeepSeek」两级搜索加重试兜底抓取，本插件更轻。

---

## 与官方 `dsh-web-deepseek-api` 的区别

DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 起官方内置了 DeepSeek Search / Fetch provider。两者不冲突，但定位不同：

| | 官方内置 | **本插件** |
|---|---|---|
| DeepSeek Search | ✅ | ✅ |
| DeepSeek Fetch | ✅ | ✅ |
| **两级 failover** | ❌ **无**（README 明确写「不会自动重试或回退至其他提供者」） | ✅ **有** |
| **Tavily 免费额度兜底** | ❌ 无 | ✅ 1000 次/月 |
| **消费 `summary` 长摘要** | ❌ 丢弃（只映射 `snippet`） | ✅ 优先使用 |
| 热切换 provider | ✅（rc.2 的 Volatile） | ❌ 需重启 |
| 维护方 | 官方 | 自己 |

⚠️ **两者同时存在时可能触发 `WEB_PROVIDER_AMBIGUOUS`**（多个可用 provider 但未显式指定）。
本插件的 patch 显式写了 `searchProvider` / `fetchProvider`，所以不会歧义；
但如果你在设置页把官方开关打开，要注意读一下最终生效的是哪个。

---

## 已知限制

1. **Tavily keyless 是匿名档**，有速率限制，随时可能被官方关闭
2. **DeepSeek Search / Fetch API 均按次计费**，各 5 元/1000 次
3. **直连抓取层不解析 JS 渲染的页面**（纯 `fetch` + HTML 转文本）
4. **抓取成功一律报 200** —— DeepSeek API 不报告目标页面状态，这是官方契约的行为
5. 无设置页，改配置需编辑 YAML 并重启

---


## 更新记录

### v0.2.0（2026-10-20）

**密钥不再随插件发布 —— 修掉一个会泄露 API Key 的安全问题**

插件目录里的 `cordis.patch.yml` 是随插件分发的文件。之前把 `apiKey` 写在那里，
等于把密钥公开（推 GitHub、发给别人、打包分发都会带上）。

- `cordis.patch.yml` 里的 `apiKey` 一律留空
- 插件新增环境变量支持：`DEEPSEEK_API_

plugins.description: Archived-conversation workspace for DeepSeek Harness: browse with previews, restore, recycle, and permanently delete — batch actions, crash-safe transactions, and an Agent-callable tool. 归档会话工作台：预览、恢复、回收站、彻底删除，支持批量与 Agent 调用。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-archive-desk · 归档工作台

> **Archived-conversation manager for DeepSeek Harness** — browse, restore, recycle, and permanently delete archived sessions.

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-archive-desk.svg?style=flat)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-archive-desk)
[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/lumidesk/dsh-archive-desk)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-archive-desk.svg?style=flat)](./LICENSE)

![dsh-archive-desk · 归档工作台](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LumiDesk/dsh-archive-desk/main/docs/assets/social-preview.png)

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）只提供「归档」：它把会话 id 藏进 `~/.dsh/storages/workspace.json`，日志继续留在磁盘上，界面上再没有任何删除入口。这个插件补上后半段——**看得见、恢复得了、删得掉**，并且把同一套能力开放给 Agent。

## 界面

侧栏点「归档工作台」进入整页管理：「已归档」与「回收站」两个页签，支持按标题 / 摘要 / 项目搜索、排序、分页、多选与批量删除；删除默认进回收站，彻底删除要显式选择 + 知情确认。列表首次加载显示骨架屏，刷新时保留旧数据。

![归档工作台 · 已归档列表](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LumiDesk/dsh-archive-desk/main/docs/assets/panel.png)

## 为什么需要它

| 不装插件                                                                 | 装上之后                                              |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| 归档会话只能靠 `archivedFilter` 在侧栏里翻                               | 一个完整的管理页：状态、搜索、排序、分页、批量操作    |
| 想删只能手改 `workspace.json` + 手动删目录（还容易被运行中的宿主写回去） | 删除走注册表 API 与事务化文件操作，不会与内存状态打架 |
| 删错了无法恢复                                                           | 默认移入回收站，可恢复；彻底删除要二次确认 + 知情勾选 |
| Agent 完全够不着归档                                                     | `archived_conversations` 工具：列、删到回收站、恢复   |

## 能力

| 能力         | 说明                                                                                       |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| 归档列表     | 侧栏图标 → 中间整页，展示标题、摘要、项目、时间、体积、状态                                |
| 状态区分     | `运行中` / `失效` / 正常；状态只看宿主是否真有活动在跑，不把「加载在内存」当用户状态       |
| 搜索与排序   | 按标题 / 摘要 / 项目 / cwd / id 过滤；最近活动 / 体积 / 标题 / 归档顺序                    |
| 分页         | 每页 10 / 20 / 50，删除后自动校正页码                                                      |
| 批量操作     | 多选、当前页全选、选择全部筛选结果、批量删除/取消归档                                      |
| 取消归档     | 行内或批量把会话移出归档集合；文件不动，侧栏行回到原项目                                   |
| 删除确认     | 默认放入回收站；彻底删除需主动切换 + 勾选「不可恢复」                                      |
| 回收站       | 删除默认移入 `~/.dsh/archive-desk/trash/`，可恢复；分页、批量恢复/彻底删除/清空            |
| 损坏条目     | 回收站里缺 meta 或 payload 的条目仍可见，只允许删除                                        |
| 失效引用清理 | 指向已不存在会话的归档记录，一键移除（只删引用，不动文件）                                 |
| 会话菜单     | 会话「…」菜单里对已归档会话多一行「删除」，复用同一个确认弹窗                              |
| Agent 工具   | `archived_conversations`：`list` / `unarchive` / `delete`（进回收站）/ `trash` / `restore` |

### 状态是什么意思

| 状态     | 判定                                           | 能否删除               |
| -------- | ---------------------------------------------- | ---------------------- |
| `运行中` | DSH 的 `workspace/session-activity` 报告有活动 | 能，先停止这些工作再删 |
| `失效`   | 归档 id 存在，但 `sessions/` 下找不到目录      | 只能移除归档引用       |
| 正常     | 目录存在、宿主没有任何活动                     | 是                     |

状态只由 DSH 的 `workspace/session-activity` 决定，它聚合 turn / job / 定时任务 / 子 Agent。`sessions.get(id)`
只是「加载进了宿主进程内存」：这个注册表是进程级的，启动后看过的会话会一直留着，归档本身也不卸载会话，
所以它既不代表用户还开着，也不代表在运行。真有活动时，删除会先把它停掉。

### 删除到底做了什么

一个会话被删除时，插件按固定顺序处理，任何一步失败都会留下可解释的状态：

1. 有活动在跑就先发出 `workspace/session-stop`，停掉 turn / job / 定时任务 / 子 Agent；
2. 会话目录移入回收站（或彻底删除）；
3. 删除投影缓存 `storages/session_projcache/sessions/<id>.json`（派生数据，可重建）；
4. 从所属 workspace 的成员列表里摘掉；
5. 从 `archivedSessionIds` 里移除；
6. 发出 `api-session/removed`，侧栏行立即消失。

停不下来的会话会被跳过并提示稍后重试；附件目录 `~/.dsh/attachments` 永不触碰（内容寻址、跨会话共享）。

### 性能

列表不重读所有日志：

- 一次扫描 `sessions/*` 建立会话路径索引；
- 列表摘要写入 `~/.dsh/archive-desk/summaries.json`，用「目录大小 + 最新 mtime」做条件缓存；
- 未命中的会话最多 4 路并发读取；
- 删除确认只查选中项（`inspect`），不拉全量列表；
- 客户端首次加载显示骨架屏，刷新保留旧数据，快速搜索会取消旧请求。

## 安装

```bash
# npm 包（推荐）：装进 web profile（dsh 会把参数转发给 pnpm）
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-archive-desk
```

桌面端把 profile 换成 `desktop`：`dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-archive-desk`。也可以从本仓库源码安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add github:LumiDesk/dsh-archive-desk`，或在 DSH 里用 `plugin_manager` 的 `install_bundle` 指向本地目录。**从本地目录安装前先 `pnpm build`**，`dist/` 不入库。安装后出现在「设置 → 插件」，侧栏出现「归档工作台」图标。

插件已收录在 [dsh-plugin.org 插件市场](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/lumidesk/dsh-archive-desk)，条目里的安装命令与上面一致。

依赖 DSH 的 `workspaceRegistry` 与 `workspace/session-activity` 接口；宿主缺少这些接口时，破坏性操作会返回 `archive/unsupported`。

## 使用

1. 点侧栏的「归档工作台」→ 打开管理页；「已归档」列出全部归档会话，「回收站」是待清理的。
2. 勾选会话 →「删除」→ 选「放入回收站」或「彻底删除」→ 确认；也可以点「取消归档」把它移出归档集合。
3. 取消归档只改 `archivedSessionIds`，不移动/删除文件；侧栏行会回到原项目。
4. 已归档会话的「…」菜单里也有「删除」，点了会跳到管理页并弹出同一个确认框。
5. 运行中的会话不参与批量勾选；要删它，用它自己的「…」菜单或 Agent 工具，插件会先停止它的工作。
6. 顶部横幅会提示有多少条引用已经失效（日志被删但归档 id 还在），点按钮一键清掉。
7. 回收站里可以单行或批量恢复、彻底删除，也可以清空整个回收站。

给 Agent 用：

```jsonc
{ "action": "list", "query": "登录", "limit": 10 }          // 看
{ "action": "unarchive", "ids": ["session-…"] }             // 取消归档，文件不动
{ "action": "delete", "ids": ["session-…"], "confirm": true } // 删到回收站
{ "action": "trash", "limit": 20 }                           // 看回收站
{ "action": "restore", "trashIds": ["2026…-session-…"] }     // 恢复
```

彻底删除**不开放给工具**：批量、不可恢复的操作留给人在面板里做。

## 无配置

这个插件没有 `settings.json`、插件配置页或环境变量开关。

- 每页条数、排序是页面上的可见控件，默认 20 / 最近活动，不持久化；
- Agent 只能删到回收站，彻底删除只由人操作；
- 摘要长度、批量上限、回收站分页等是代码常量，不是部署旋钮。

理由很简单：归档管理工具的安全边界应该由代码固定，而不是让用户或部署者去调一个可能被误改的开关。

## 权限与安全

插件是本地用户态工具：没有账号、没有网络请求、没有遥测。

| 范围                   | 行为                                                                           |
| ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `~/.dsh/sessions/*`    | 读取标题 / 摘要 / 时间 / 体积；删除时把会话目录移入回收站或移除                |
| `~/.dsh/storages/`     | 只通过 DSH 注册表 API 增删归档 id 与 workspace 成员，不直接改 `workspace.json` |
| `~/.dsh/archive-desk/` | 写回收站、摘要缓存（`summaries.json`）与启动诊断（`last-boot.json`）           |
| `~/.dsh/attachments`   | 不读写（内容寻址、跨会话共享）                                                 |

破坏性操作一律要人工确认：删除默认进回收站，彻底删除必须主动切换并勾选「不可恢复」；Agent 工具只能删到回收站。

## 技术栈

| 层          | 选择                                                          | 为什么                                                                         |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| 语言        | TypeScript（`strict`，ESM）                                   | 插件要碰会话日志、注册表与文件系统，类型是最便宜的护栏                         |
| Host 构建   | `tsc` → `dist/index.js`                                       | 不需要打包器；Node 直接加载 ESM                                                |
| Client 构建 | `esbuild` → `dist/client.js`（minify）                        | 浏览器半必须是单个 `__ModuleLoader__` 工厂文件                                 |
| Client UI   | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`（external）           | 复用宿主的 Modal/Toast/Button/Tabs，自动跟随主题；不打包第二份组件             |
| 传输        | 自注册 HTTP 前缀路由 + `connection.requestRejection`          | 宿主的 `connection.rpc.handle` 在组合 profile 里不可用（见 docs/设计.md §4.2） |
| 状态        | `ctx.workspaceRegistry` 的公开 API                            | 直接改 `workspace.json` 会被宿主内存状态覆盖                                   |
| 活动判定    | `workspace/session-activity` 瀑布                             | 与 DSH 自己的归档准入一致，不会把「已加载」当成「运行中」                      |
| 存储        | 文件系统（回收站两阶段写入 + 摘要缓存）                       | 会话本身就是目录，移动目录比复制快且原子                                       |
| 测试        | `node:test`（零依赖）+ 宿主自己的 `assertSupportedJsonSchema` | 测试直接跑 TS，工具 schema 用宿主同一个校验函数把关                            |
| 质量        | Prettier + ESLint + Commitlint + Husky/lint-staged            | 提交前自动格式化、检查、校验提交信息                                           |

## 工程结构

```
src/host/index.ts        Host 入口：HTTP 路由、能力探测、工具注册、启动诊断
src/host/service.ts      业务：列表 / 删除事务 / 恢复 / 清空 / 清理失效引用
src/host/paths.ts        路径解析、id 校验、体积/指纹、跨卷与越界保护
src/host/cache.ts        列表摘要缓存（summaries.json）
src/host/trash.ts        回收站存储（两阶段写入 + 恢复事务 + 损坏条目）
src/host/tool.ts

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1 side-chat plugin: a docked right-Sidebar chat tab with shared session context, selection-marked questions, streaming replies and a Ctrl+J shortcut
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-sidechat

面向 **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1** Web GUI 的侧边聊天插件。

侧边聊天以**右侧栏停靠标签页**的形式存在，与「工作区文件 / 新建终端 / 浏览器」共用同一个入口：
只有主动打开时才出现，不悬浮、不遮挡主对话。它会自动共享**当前会话的对话内容**；在主对话中
用鼠标**划选**一段内容后，可一键将其作为引用带入并直接提问。

- 目标运行时：**DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2**（Desktop / Web）
- 安装方式：DSH 插件管理器一键导入，Git 地址 `github:JiaskyNo1/dsh-sidechat`
- 开源协议：MIT

## 安装（一键导入）

本仓库是可直接导入的 bundle 包：`lib/` 已包含构建产物，安装器会自动完成依赖安装、
bundle 选择与配置注册，**无需构建、无需手动改配置**。

1. 打开 DSH 侧边栏 → **插件（Plugins）** → **添加插件**。
2. 在 Git 地址栏粘贴：

   ```
   github:JiaskyNo1/dsh-sidechat
   ```

3. 安装完成后启用插件。当前页面通常会热加载；若未出现，重启 DSH 即可。

## 功能

| 功能 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 右侧栏停靠 | 注册为右侧栏标签类型（`kind: sidechat`），与内置的文件 / 终端 / 浏览器标签并列 |
| 快捷键 | `Ctrl+J`（Desktop）/ `Ctrl+Alt+J`（Web）打开；指南卡片与快捷键参考显示按键提示 |
| 会话上下文 | 自动注入当前会话最近 40 条消息（含工具调用与结果，按字符预算截断）、项目根目录、Git 分支与工作区 AGENTS.md 指令 |
| 与主对话一致 | 使用与主对话相同的模型与推理等级、路由默认采样参数；思考过程采用主界面的「思考 / 已思考」折叠样式 |
| 划选引用 | 划选主对话文本后点击「添加到侧边聊天」，引用以草稿形式插入输入框；补充问题并发送后才回答 |
| 回答质量 | 不覆盖 temperature/maxTokens，沿用路由默认值；上下文包含主对话的工具调用与结果，便于给出有依据的回答 |
| 流式输出 | 逐字流式显示，可中途停止 |
| 思考过程 | 可折叠的「💭 思考过程」块 |
| Markdown | 标题、代码块、列表、引用、链接、表格 |
| 模型选择 | 标签页内切换模型与推理等级 |
| 会话隔离 | 每个会话维护独立的侧边聊天历史 |
| 清空 | 二次确认后清空当前会话的侧边聊天 |

## 工作原理

```
浏览器 (lib/client.js)
├── ctx.remote.$mount(TYPERT_REMOTE)          挂载 sidechat Remote
├── ctx.sidebarRightTabs.register({ kind })   注册侧边栏标签类型
├── sidebar.right.pane.tab (key: dsh-sidechat) 停靠标签页正文
├── ctx.shortcuts.register('sidechat.open')   Ctrl+J / Ctrl+Alt+J
└── shell.overlay                              划选时出现的「添加到侧边聊天」按钮
        │
        │ Typert Remote（JSON over /api）
        ▼
宿主 (lib/index.js)
└── SidechatService
    ├── getContext(sessionId)  项目根 / Git 分支 / 会话最近 12 条消息
    ├── models()               provider / model / reasoning effort 目录
    ├── start(messages)        调用 llm.stream 生成，返回 job id
    ├── poll(jobId)            返回累计文本、思考过程、完成状态与错误
    └── stop(jobId)            停止任务
```

设计要点：

- 宿主半运行时只依赖 `zod`；`@deepseek-ai/*` 均为类型导入，安装后无需解析对等依赖。
- 浏览器半只使用 Web 平台共享模块表中的 `react` / `react/jsx-runtime` / `zod`。
- 宿主 `./typert` 导出为手写 strict manifest，由 `dsh-typert-loader` 自动发现并注册。
- 标签页正文注册在 session-scoped 的 `sidebar.right.pane.tab`，每个会话自动获得独立实例。

## 使用

| 操作 | 方式 |
| --- | --- |
| 打开 | 右侧栏「打开右侧边栏」→ 指南页「侧边聊天」卡片；或按 `Ctrl+J`（Web 为 `Ctrl+Alt+J`） |
| 关闭 | 标签页上的 ✕ |
| 划选引用 | 选中主对话文字 → 点击「添加到侧边聊天」→ 引用草稿插入输入框 → 补充问题后按 Enter / 点击「发送」 |
| 切换模型 | 标签页底部下拉框选择模型与推理等级 |
| 停止生成 | 生成中点击「停止」 |
| 清空 | 标签页头部「清空」，二次确认 |

侧边聊天是独立问答面：不写入主会话，也不会调用工具。

- 本面板没有工具；若模型尝试输出工具调用标记，会被过滤并按需重试，不会把原始标记显示出来。

## 构建与开发

需要 Node.js 24 与安装好依赖的 DSH 0.2.1 运行时（`@deepseek-ai/*` 包）。

```bash
pnpm install                       # 安装开发依赖
pnpm run typecheck                 # tsc --noEmit
pnpm run build                     # tsc 中间产物 + tsdown 构建
```

构建产物：

| 文件 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `lib/index.js` | 宿主半（ESM） |
| `lib/typert.js` | 宿主 strict Typert manifest |
| `lib/types.js` | wire 类型模块（运行时为空） |
| `lib/client.js` | 浏览器 bundle，`window.__ModuleLoader__.load` 包装，CSS Modules 内联 |

构建中间产物（`lib/types/`、`lib/*.map`）已被 `.gitignore` 排除，不进入仓库。

## 兼容性

- 目标版本：DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2**。
- 使用的 client 契约：`client-modules` 的 bundle 格式、`ui-sidebar-right` 标签注册、
  `ui-slots` keyed slot、`client-shortcuts` 命令注册、`typert` Remote 协议。
- 跨 DSH 版本升级时，需要同步调整 `package.json` 的 peerDependencies 与 `tsdown.config.ts`
  中的平台共享模块表。

## 项目结构

```
.
├── cordis.patch.yml        # bundle 补丁：声明本包
├── src/
│   ├── index.ts            # 宿主半：SidechatService
│   ├── typert.ts           # 宿主 strict Typert manifest
│   ├── types.ts            # wire 类型
│   └── client/
│       ├── index.ts        # 浏览器半入口
│       ├── apply.tsx       # 标签类型 / 标签正文 / 快捷键 / 划选按钮 / Markdown
│       ├── remote.ts       # 浏览器侧 Remote contribution
│       ├── settings.ts     # 偏好存储（localStorage）
│       └── sidechat.module.css
├── lib/                    # 预构建产物（安装即用）
├── tsconfig.json
└── tsdown.config.ts
```

## 更新记录

版本变化与升级说明见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。

## 致谢与许可

- 上游实现：[kittsai/dsh-sidechat](https://github.com/kittsai/dsh-sidechat)（MIT）。
- 本项目同样以 **MIT** 发布，详见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)；版权声明与上游保持一致。

plugins.description: Render Mermaid code blocks in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI as SVG with Pele (no mermaid.js runtime).
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-pele-mermaid

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) | English · [GitHub](https://github.com/lsy1998/dsh-pele-mermaid) · [Issues](https://github.com/lsy1998/dsh-pele-mermaid/issues)

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/lsy1998/dsh-pele-mermaid.git
cd dsh-pele-mermaid
npm install
npm run build
```

Render Mermaid fenced code blocks in the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI as SVG diagrams with
**Pele** — no mermaid.js runtime is bundled or loaded.

**Topics:** `deepseek-harness` · `dsh-plugin` · `mermaid` · `plugin`

[Pele](https://github.com/obsidianmd/pele) is the lightweight Mermaid-to-SVG renderer from the
Obsidian team (`pele@1.9.0`, MIT). It supports the diagram types built into **Mermaid 12.1.0**
and is themed with CSS variables.

Every Mermaid code block gets a **Code / Diagram** toggle, a fullscreen zoom viewer, standalone
SVG export, DSW theme adaptation, and a clean fallback to source when a diagram cannot be
rendered.

- Package: `dsh-pele-mermaid` `0.1.0`
- Intended profile: `desktop`, owned by the DSH Desktop application
- Renderer: `pele@1.9.0`, served from a same-origin plugin route

## Features

- Renders `mermaid`, `mermaidjs` and `mmd` fenced code blocks, and also recovers
  DSH/Shiki's plain fallback (a code element with no `language-` class) when Pele recognizes a
  Mermaid keyword at the start of the block.
- Never enhances a code block labelled with another `language-*` class, and never touches inline
  `code`.
- **Code / Diagram** toggle buttons with `aria-pressed`; diagram view is the default, and the
  original `pre` element is preserved for code view.
- Toolbar badge that names the detected diagram type next to "Pele", plus fullscreen and
  **Download SVG** actions.
- Zoom and pan in place: the **Zoom in / Zoom out / Reset zoom** buttons in the toolbar, hold
  `Ctrl` (or `Cmd`) and scroll the wheel to zoom at the pointer, drag to pan, and use `+`,
  `-`, `0` and the arrow keys. A plain wheel still scrolls the page. The state is per block and
  resets when the diagram re-renders.
- Fullscreen viewer: zoom in / out / reset / fit, drag to pan, `Ctrl` or `Cmd` + wheel to zoom at
  the pointer, `Escape` to close, focus trapped while open and returned to the trigger on close,
  `role="dialog"` and `aria-modal="true"`. It opens at the inline zoom and restores the inline
  scroll position and zoom when you close it.
- Exports a standalone `.svg` file named `pele-<type>-YYYYMMDD-HHmmss.svg` whose root carries the
  resolved theme variables, so it looks the same outside DSH. The export is always the **whole
  diagram at its natural size** — zooming or panning first does not crop it.
- Adapts to the DSW light and dark themes by mapping DSW design tokens onto Pele CSS variables.
  Colour changes need no re-render; geometry-only changes re-render the affected diagrams.
- Falls back to the diagram source with a localized error message — including Pele's line and
  column when it provides them — instead of leaving a broken diagram.
- Rejects individual diagrams over **50,000 characters** or **2,000 lines** before rendering and
  keeps them as source with a localized notice.
- Localizes every plugin-owned string in **English** and **Simplified Chinese**, and switches
  live when the document language changes.
- Renders through a serial queue, yields between diagrams to keep the page responsive, and
  discards stale asynchronous results while a response is still streaming.
- Idempotent and disposable: repeated enable/disable cycles leave no duplicate toolbars,
  observers or listeners behind.
- Accessible: localized `aria-label`s, accessible names on rendered diagrams, polite
  `aria-live` status announcements, and preserved `focus-visible` outlines.

## Requirements

- The DSH Web GUI with the `desktop` profile. This release was verified against the bundled
  desktop runtime `0.2.1-rc.2` (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.2.1-rc.2`)
  and the standalone `dsh` CLI `0.1.7-rc.1`.
- Node.js 22.18 or later for building from source (the version this release was built and tested with); the package declares
  `engines.node >= 22.18.0`.
- DSH is a developer preview. Its plugin loader and Markdown DOM may change between releases.

## Install

The plugin ships as a DSH profile plugin bundle. Its `package.json` declares
`dsh.bundle.patch = ./cordis.patch.yml`, which inserts the bundle entry `ui-pele-mermaid`.

### Recommended: install from the DSH app (desktop profile)

The `desktop` profile is managed by the DSH Desktop / DSH Web application, so install from the
app:

1. Clone the repository and build it:

   ```powershell
   git clone https://github.com/lsy1998/dsh-pele-mermaid.git
   cd dsh-pele-mermaid
   npm install
   npm run build
   ```

2. Open the DSH Web GUI and select **Plugins** in the sidebar.
3. Install a plugin and point it at the absolute package directory you just cloned, for example
   `C:\path\to\dsh-pele-mermaid` (`Resolve-Path` prints it).
4. Let the run finish and enable the bundle it added.
5. Restart DSH Web, or refresh the page, and open a session that contains a Mermaid block.

The app performs the package-manager call itself and registers the new bundle. The equivalent
invocation is:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add -w --save-exact <absolute-path-to-dsh-pele-mermaid>
```

> **Verified caveat.** A standalone `dsh` CLI refuses the `desktop` profile:
> `dsh plugin --profile desktop --help` exits with status 1 and prints
> `error: profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`; the guard is
> present in both the globally installed `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.1.7-rc.1` and the bundled
> `0.2.1-rc.2`. Run that form from the app-managed context (the **Plugins** page), not from a
> plain terminal. `--profile web` is the CLI-installable alternative.

### Command line (web profile)

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add -w --save-exact <absolute-path-to-dsh-pele-mermaid>
```

Without a global `dsh` command, invoke the published CLI through `npx` (needs network access):

```powershell
npx.cmd --yes @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add -w --save-exact <absolute-path-to-dsh-pele-mermaid>
```

Restart DSH Web or refresh the page after installing.

### Installer script

`bin/dsh-pele-mermaid.mjs` (also exposed as the `dsh-pele-mermaid` bin) wraps the same command:

```powershell
# run from the package directory
node bin/dsh-pele-mermaid.mjs install
node bin/dsh-pele-mermaid.mjs install --profile web --source .
node bin/dsh-pele-mermaid.mjs uninstall --profile web
node bin/dsh-pele-mermaid.mjs --help
```

- `install [--profile <name>] [--source <spec>]` and `uninstall [--profile <name>]`.
- `--profile` defaults to `web`, because the CLI cannot manage `desktop`; `--profile desktop` is
  refused with an explanatory message.
- `--source` accepts a package spec, an absolute path, or a `./`-relative path resolved against the
  current directory; without it the script installs the package directory it lives in.
- `--help` prints bilingual English / Simplified Chinese usage.
- The script forwards to `dsh plugin --profile <name> add -w --save-exact <spec>` (uninstall:
  `remove -w <name>`) and exits non-zero with a clear message when `dsh` is missing.

For the `desktop` profile, use the app **Plugins** page instead: the CLI cannot manage it.

## Update and uninstall

Web profile:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web update -w dsh-pele-mermaid
dsh plugin --profile web remove -w dsh-pele-mermaid
```

For the `desktop` profile, update or remove the bundle from the app's **Plugins** page.

Restart DSH Web, or refresh the page, after updating or uninstalling.

## Usage

Ask a model to output a Mermaid fenced code block:

````markdown
```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A[Code] --> B[Diagram]
```
````

The block becomes a card that wraps the original `pre`. Diagram view is shown first; the
**Code** button reveals the untouched source, and **Diagram** switches back. Fullscreen and
**Download SVG** are available whenever a diagram rendered successfully.

## Behaviour and limits

| Area | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Detection | `pre > code` blocks whose class contains `language-mermaid`, `languag

plugins.readme_text:
# my-plugins

> DeepSeek Harness 插件集合 · A collection of DeepSeek Harness plugins

![Startup Splash](docs/splash.webp)

每个插件都是可独立安装的 Harness bundle，统一放在 [`packages/`](packages) 下，版本、变更记录与校验流程各自独立。

## 插件列表

| 插件 | 版本 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Startup Splash](packages/startup-splash) | 2.1.1 | 首帧即启动：预启动层 + 曲速隧道、粒子爆发、故障字标与 HUD |

## 安装

1. 克隆仓库并记下路径：

   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/wk-single/my-plugins.git
   ```

2. 在 DeepSeek Harness 中以**本地 bundle 目录**安装插件：

   - 让 Harness 助手执行 `plugin_manager install_bundle`，目标为
     `<repo>/packages/startup-splash`；
   - 或在 Harness 的插件管理界面选择该目录（若你的版本提供本地目录安装入口）。

3. 生效后，每次打开或刷新 Web 界面都会播放启动动画。点击任意处、按 `Esc` 可跳过。

> 插件只向 `shell.overlay` 注册一个浮层，不修改 Harness 的其它行为；禁用或卸载后立即恢复。

## 目录结构

```
packages/
  startup-splash/       一个可独立安装的 Harness bundle
    package.json        dsh.bundle / dsh.client 清单
    cordis.patch.yml    Loader 行
    index.js            Host 半侧
    client.js           Client 半侧（动画与 slot 注册）
    locale/             插件管理器显示文案（en / zh）
    icon.svg            插件图标
docs/
  splash.webp           实际启动画面截图（v2.0.0）
scripts/
  validate.mjs          清单与结构校验
```

## 开发约定

**版本**

- 每个插件独立遵循 [SemVer](https://semver.org/)；破坏性变更升主版本。
- 发布时打 tag：`<plugin>-v<version>`，例如 `startup-splash-v2.0.0`。
- 变更写入根目录 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)（Keep a Changelog 格式）。

**提交**

- 使用 [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)：
  `feat(startup-splash): ...`、`fix(...)`、`docs(...)`、`chore(...)`。
- 一个提交只做一件事；提交信息用中文或英文均可，但同一仓库保持一致。

**校验**

- 本地：`npm run validate` 校验清单、导出、locale、图标与工厂 id 一致性。
- `npm run check` 会同时跑清单校验与 JS 语法检查；`scripts/validate.mjs` 可直接接入任意 CI。
- 新增插件：在 `packages/` 下新建目录，补齐清单、patch、locale 与图标，并加入上方表格。

**分支**

- `main` 保持可安装、可回滚；较大的改动走分支与 PR。
- 历史只追加不重写（不使用 force push）。

## 许可证

[Apache License 2.0](LICENSE)。Copyright 2026 wanka.

---

## English

`my-plugins` is a small collection of installable DeepSeek Harness plugins. Each directory under `packages/` is a self-contained Harness bundle with its own manifest, Loader patch, client code, locales and icon.

The first plugin, **Startup Splash**, plays a full-viewport boot sequence (warp starfield, aurora fields, energy core, HUD) whenever the Harness Web UI opens, then fades out. Click or press `Esc` to skip.

Install it by cloning this repository and adding `packages/startup-splash` as a local bundle in Harness. See the package README for details.

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-custom-splash

A startup-screen plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) (DSH):
play **your own video** full-screen while DSH boots, then fade into the app.

中文详细说明：[README.zh.md](README.zh.md)

![video splash](docs/screenshots/video-splash.png)

---

## Features

- **Video mode (default)** — a local MP4 covering the window, auto-fading into the app when it ends.
- **Swap the video without reinstalling** — drop any MP4 at
  `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\startup-video\boot.mp4` (or `~/.dsh/startup-video/boot.mp4`),
  or point the setting at any absolute path (file or directory).
- **No first-frame flash** — the lock class is added synchronously in `<head>` and the
  black overlay is the first child of `<body>`, so the app never paints before the video.
- **Streams with HTTP Range** — `/dsh-startup/media/<file>` supports `206`, `HEAD` and
  seeking, and is served with `Cache-Control: no-store`.
- **Never hangs the boot** — autoplay rejection falls back to muted + an "unmute" button;
  decode errors, a 25 s watchdog and script failures all release the page immediately.
- **Skippable** — bottom-right skip button, `Esc`, or click (after 0.9 s).
- **Per-session by default** — a refresh in the same tab does not replay it;
  `always` / `daily` are also available.

> **Note**: The built-in six-act interactive sequence from the upstream project is currently disabled in this v1.0.0 fork due to a DOM mounting compatibility issue. It will be restored in a future update.

---

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-custom-splash-1.0.0.tgz
```

On Windows, unzip the release and double-click `安装.cmd`.

For **DeepSeek Harness Desktop**, install the `.tgz` through its plugin manager
(the desktop profile cannot be managed from the CLI), then fully quit from the tray
and relaunch — closing the window is not enough.

Requirements: DSH web profile or Desktop, Node `>= 20`, no runtime dependencies.

Uninstall:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-custom-splash
```

---

## Use your own video

Fastest path — overwrite one file:

```
%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\startup-video\boot.mp4
```

If that file is missing the plugin falls back to its own `lib/assets/video/boot.mp4`,
so deleting it never leaves you with a black screen.

Prefer another location? **Settings → Startup screen → Video absolute path** accepts a
file or a directory (relative paths are rejected). Leave it empty to use the bundled clip.

Encode for the browser (H.264 + yuv420p + AAC, `faststart`):

```bash
ffmpeg -i source.mov -vf scale=1920:1080:flags=lanczos \
  -c:v libx264 -preset medium -crf 20 -pix_fmt yuv420p \
  -c:a aac -b:a 192k -movflags +faststart boot.mp4
```

---

## Settings

**DSH Settings → "Startup screen"** (labels are in Chinese).

Playback: enabled · source (`video` / `builtin`) · video absolute path · video file name ·
fit (`cover` / `contain`) · muted · volume · mode (`session` / `always` / `daily`) · allow skip.

Builtin sequence only: theme · speed · require confirmation · identity name/id/clearance ·
voice (on/off, source, voice, rate, pitch, volume, cue sound, intro delay) · UI sounds ·
accent and glitch colors · all copy fields.

The builtin-only fields are hidden automatically in video mode.

---

## FAQ

- **Nothing shows up** — check that the "Startup screen" section exists in Settings
  (otherwise the bundle is not mounted), that "Enabled" is on, and that mode is not
  `session` with the tab already visited. On Desktop, quit from the tray.
- **Video does not play** — verify H.264/yuv420p/AAC, or enable "Muted" (muted autoplay is
  exempt from browser autoplay policies). Failures release the page instead of hanging it.
- **No sound** — browsers require a user gesture before audio; a muted fallback with an
  "unmute" button is provided.
- **401 from `/dsh-startup/*`** — expected: those routes only trust loopback requests
  carrying the host's trust marker.

---

## How it works

```
Host (lib/index.js)
  tapIndex → <head>: critical CSS + config + EARLY_LOCK_JS
           → <body>: #dsh-startup-root overlay + BOOTSTRAP_JS (mode checks, 9 s fallback)
  routes (/dsh-startup): splash.css · splash.js · boot-video.js · media/<file> · asset/<file>.mp3 · config
Browser
  lib/boot-video.js  overlay + <video> + skip/unmute + watchdog
  lib/client.js      settings panel (self-boots the overlay if the host did not inject it)
```

---

## Development

```bash
npm test               # four smoke suites (254 assertions)
npm run pack:release   # npm pack into release/
```

Repo layout:

```
lib/index.js       host half: config, injection, six routes
lib/boot-video.js  video runtime (zero deps, all styles inline)
lib/splash.js      builtin six-act runtime
lib/splash.css     builtin six-act styles
lib/client.js      settings panel
lib/assets/        audio + video assets
test/              smoke suites
preview/           offline preview page (not published)
docs/              screenshots and publishing notes
```

---

## License & credits

MIT. Based on [`6shenhonghong9/dsh-startup-screen`]
(MIT) — the builtin six-act sequence, its styles, audio assets and copy come from there.
This fork adds the video mode, replaceable video path, first-frame flash fix and the
related settings.

plugins.description: Read-only DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that surfaces the official Auto Review verdicts — review records and host-outcome evidence — in a sidebar panel. / DSH 自动审阅功能日志抓取
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-auto-review-panel 中文 | [English](./README.en.md)
## 项目简介 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的 Auto 权限预设由 Auto Review 审查器在后台裁决每一次工具调用——允许、放行还是拒绝——但这些裁决对使用者几乎不可见：调用被放行时悄无声息，被拒绝时只有一条结果消息。 本插件是一个不修改上游任何代码的外部扩展，给 Auto Review 装上**一块看得见的面板**：把审查器的判定、风险等级与依据呈现在侧栏里，让"这次调用为什么被放行/拒绝"不再是一个只能从会话消息里猜的黑盒。 - **只读呈现，不改裁决**：面板是审查状态的一个 UI/传输面，不是第二个审查器。授权策略、风险分级与来源分类完全由官方 Auto Review 负责（语义见[上游调研](./docs/reference/upstream-auto-review.md)），本插件不裁决、不拦截、不重算任何调用——审查内容经 `llm/stream` 的只读观察接缝捕获——指纹匹配不上即不记录，绝不误报（[ADR-0003](./docs/decisions/ADR-0003-review-record-capture.md)）。 - **历史按会话持久化**：审查记录落盘到 `/auto-review-panel/v1/`（默认 `~/.dsh/auto-review-panel/v1/`），`dsh` 重启后按会话恢复；Auto Review 已停用、或会话不再用 Auto preset 时历史照常展示；未关联记录（上游 `deny+never` 拦截的批次）在任何会话视图恒可见。默认不限量，留存上限与清理入口在插件管理页本插件条目的配置页（见[用户指南](./docs/guide/README.md#审查历史存在哪里存多久)与 [ADR-0004](./docs/decisions/ADR-0004-review-record-persistence.md)）。 - **host/client 分半**：宿主半部承载审查状态的读取通道，浏览器半部把它渲染进侧栏；两半之间走 DSH 的 Connection 通道，不私开 HTTP 面。 - **不配等于没装**：宿主 DSH 版本不在支持清单上、或核心包混装时，插件行不启动，组合退化为"没装这个插件"——这是刻意的 fail-closed，见 [ADR-0001](./docs/decisions/ADR-0001-dsh-compat-contract.md)。 首个版本 `v0.1.0` 已就绪：审查记录捕获、宿主结局佐证、`sidebar.right` 面板与按会话持久化均已落地，并在真实组合上经 `pnpm smoke:live` 对照官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-auto-review@0.2.1-rc.2`（npm `next`）验收（含落盘与重启恢复）。进度与发布状态见[路线图 §进度总账](./docs/plans/completed/2026-10-20-auto-review-panel.md#进度总账)。 ## 环境要求 **使用本插件**：一个下表中的 DSH 版本（精确匹配，不是范围）。`dsh plugin` 负责安装，无需本地 Node 工具链。 | DSH 系列 | 受支持的版本 | | --- | --- | | `0.2.1` | `0.2.1-rc.2` | DSH 版本不在表内、或 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` 各包版本不一致时，插件不会启动，行为等同没装。 **从源码构建 / 贡献**：Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24`，pnpm `11.25.0`（建议经 corepack 启用）；开发 pin 的 DSH 为 `0.2.1-rc.2`。 **运行平台**：macOS、Linux、Windows——面板是 UI 面，无平台特定执行语义；Windows CI 腿默认停放，面板出现平台相关行为时再由仓库变量 `DSH_WINDOWS_CI` 启用。 ## 安装 插件尚未发布到 npm。当前仅支持从本地源码安装： ```sh git clone https://github.com/cherrchen/dsh-auto-review-panel.git cd dsh-auto-review-panel export CI=true pnpm install pnpm build dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/repo ``` > [!TIP] > `dsh` 不在 PATH 里时（例如用源码仓库跑 DSH），把命令里的 `dsh` 换成 `pnpm dsh`。 **前置条件**：本插件只观察已有审查器的裁决，自身不审查。要看到内容，需先在插件管理器启用官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-auto-review`（它随安装附带、默认关闭）；若当前安装未附带，再显式安装精确版 `0.2.1-rc.2`，勿用滞后的 `latest`，并让会话选择 Auto preset——两者缺一，面板将恒为空。 ## 运行方法 开发自检： ```sh pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck pnpm build pnpm test pnpm smoke pnpm docs:check ``` 安装进 DSH 运行时并验证组合： ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/repo dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A3 'auto-review-panel' ``` 预期输出： ```text # == @dsh-electron/dsh-auto-review-panel - id: auto-review-panel-compat name: '@dsh-electron/dsh-auto-review-panel/compat' - id: auto-review-panel name: '@dsh-electron/dsh-auto-review-panel/panel' - id: auto-review-panel-client name: '@dsh-electron/dsh-auto-review-panel' ``` 即插件自身的三行全部挂载：`auto-review-panel-compat` 是启动门禁，`auto-review-panel` 是面板的宿主半部（持有 `autoReviewPanelCompat`，门禁不过即不启动），`auto-review-panel-client` 挂在裸包名上、是 web 客户端图读取 `dsh.client` 声明的唯一锚点。 ## 项目结构 ```text . ├── src/ │ ├── compat.ts auto-review-panel-compat 启动门禁（版本 allowlist 与混装判定） │ ├── compat/dsh-version.ts 兼容性契约本体：SUPPORTED_DSH_RELEASES、核心包清单、分类与判定 │ ├── compat/review-fingerprint.ts 官方 Auto Review 请求的结构指纹 │ ├── capture.ts llm/stream 只读 tee 与裁决协议解析 │ ├── host.ts 捕获核心：在飞关联、宿主结局佐证、通道端点体 │ ├── channel.ts PANEL_CHANNEL 挂载（connection.rpc.handle，软接缝） │ ├── records.ts 双环形记录缓冲与列表投影 │ ├── history/ 按会话 JSONL 持久化（contract/format/paths/store/lazy） │ ├── contract.ts host/client 共享 wire 契约 │ ├── panel.ts 面板的宿主半部：autoReviewPanel 服务行 │ ├── client/ 浏览器半部：面板组件、轮询数据源、留存设置页、文案与样式 │ └── index.ts 公共面 barrel；其空 apply 同时承载裸包名的 client 图锚点行 ├── tests/ 宿主捕获/缓冲/通道、兼容性判定、patch 不变量、client 面板与制品形态 ├── scripts/ 冒烟（compose / packed / live）、兼容性契约检查、打包门禁、升级流程、lefthook 安装器 └── docs/ 需求、架构、决策记录（ADR）、计划、开发工作流、故障排查 ``` ## 贡献指南 欢迎 Issue 与 PR： 1. 先读 [`AGENTS.md`](./AGENTS.md)（仓库级规则）与[开发工作流](./docs/development/plugin-development-workflow.md)（环境、命令、运行时支持矩阵、升级流程）。 2. 从 `main` 拉分支；提交信息遵循 conventional commits（`feat` / `fix` / `perf` / `refactor` + scope），参见现有历史。 3. PR 前本地必须全部通过：`pnpm lint`、`pnpm typecheck`、`pnpm build`、`pnpm test`、`pnpm docs:check`、`pnpm smoke`（CI 按同序执行，先 build 后 test）。 4. 影响行为的变更需同批更新 `docs/` 下的对应文档；README 保持中英双语同步；有取舍的工程决策请新增 ADR。 5. 硬约束：**不修改上游仓库（deepseek-harness）任何包**；插件只做 out-of-tree 扩展。 ## 已知限制 - 记录以**明文** JSONL 落盘在 `/auto-review-panel/v1/`：含审查请求全文与推理原文，不加密、不上传——共享机器请按本地敏感文件对待；没有"关闭持久化"开关（面板的读路径经同一存储）。 - 不做跨会话历史浏览：无会话视图只显示当前进程内存里的记录；未关联记录（没有 `correlation.callId` 锚）如实显示在「未关联」组、无宿主结局佐证。 - 支持矩阵是精确版本 allowlist：宿主版本不在清单上、或核心包混装了不同版本时，被门禁的 `auto-review-panel` 行**不启动**，组合退化为"没装这个插件"（[ADR-0001](./docs/decisions/ADR-0001-dsh-compat-contract.md)）。 - 官方 Auto Review 不提供专用的面板数据源接口：审查判定与原因需要从宿主侧的既有接缝读取，上游一旦改变这些接缝的形状，只能由适配层或升级车道发现——本插件不承诺跨版本的语义直通（[上游调研](./docs/reference/upstream-auto-review.md)）。 ## 文档 项目长期文档位于 [`docs/`](./docs/README.md)： - [版本变更记录（CHANGELOG）](./CHANGELOG.md) - [用户指南](./docs/guide/README.md) - [需求](./docs/requirements/auto-review-panel.md) - [上游 Auto Review 调研](./docs/reference/upstream-auto-review.md) - [决策记录（ADR）](./docs/decisions/README.md) - [计划](./docs/plans/README.md) - [开发工作流](./docs/development/plugin-development-workflow.md) - [常见问题排查](./docs/troubleshooting/README.md) Coding Agent 的仓库级规则定义于 [`AGENTS.md`](./AGENTS.md)。 ## 许可证 [MIT](./LICENSE)

plugins.description: 中文前端界面设计规范 DSH 插件：zh-ui-design skill + UI lint / Chinese UI design spec plugin for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-zh-ui English | [中文](README.zh.md) A DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) plugin for Chinese-language UI work. It has three parts: 1. **Skill `zh-ui-design`**: Chinese typography rules (spacing between Chinese and Latin/digits, full-width punctuation, CJK font stacks with fallbacks, line-height 1.6–1.8, 25–40 characters per line), an anti-"generated look" checklist, and a "design direction first" workflow and 4 style presets (observatory, night-shift, cobalt-poster, trust), each with complete CSS custom properties and nav / hero / pricing-card / CTA recipes. Preset text/background pairs are checked against WCAG AA (4.5:1). 2. **Project spec injection**: on every prompt assembly, reads `DESIGN.md` and `design.tokens.json` from the session's working directory and appends them as runtime context (not the cached system prompt). Nothing is injected when the files are absent. 3. **Tool `zh_design_lint`**: static scan of HTML / CSS / SCSS / Vue / JSX / TSX / Svelte sources and Tailwind classes. It does not render pages. ## zh_design_lint rules | Rule | What it reports | |---|---| | `hardcoded-color` | Literal colors outside custom-property definitions (`--x:`), and Tailwind arbitrary colors `bg-[#…]`. Colors listed in `design.tokens.json` are allowed. | | `off-scale-px` | px values in margin / padding / gap / font-size / border-radius / inset properties that are not multiples of the spacing base (default 4px); Tailwind `p-[13px]` etc. 0, 1, 2 and token px values are allowed. | | `font-family-cjk` | `font-family` stacks with no Chinese font (PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, Noto Sans SC, …). `var(...)`, `inherit` and monospace stacks are skipped. | | `cjk-latin-spacing` | Visible text where a Chinese character directly touches a Latin letter or digit. | | `cjk-punctuation` | Half-width `, ; : ! ? .` next to Chinese characters. | | `cjk-line-height` | Unitless `line-height` below 1.5 on body-text selectors (headings, buttons, prices etc. excluded); `leading-none/tight/snug` on `

`, `

  • ` and similar. | | `purple-gradient` | Gradients containing a violet/purple color (hue 250°–320°); Tailwind `from/via/to-purple|violet|fuchsia-*`. | | `emoji-icon` | Emoji in visible text (symbols such as `©` and `™` are not counted). | | `heading-subtitle` | Two or more headings each followed by a short subtitle paragraph, or an eyebrow + heading + subtitle triplet. | | `filler-copy` | Stock marketing filler (一站式, 赋能, 无缝, seamless, elevate your …). | Known limits: the CSS parsing is regex-based, not a full parser; color keywords such as `white` are not detected; contrast, tap-target size and rendered font sizes are not measured — use a rendering tool for those (for example `design_audit` from [dsh-design](https://github.com/Viger1/dsh-design)). ## Install ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:1186258278/dsh-zh-ui ``` For local development, mount the build output with a patch: ```yaml # extra.yml - insert: - id: zh-ui name: '/absolute/path/to/dsh-zh-ui/lib/index.js' ``` ```sh dsh web --patch ./extra.yml ``` Requires Node 22+ (a `dsh` requirement). ## Configuration ```yaml - id: zh-ui name: dsh-zh-ui config: registerSkill: true injectProjectSpec: true specFiles: [DESIGN.md, design.tokens.json] maxSpecChars: 8000 rules: [hardcoded-color, off-scale-px, font-family-cjk, cjk-latin-spacing, cjk-punctuation, cjk-line-height, purple-gradient, emoji-icon, heading-subtitle, filler-copy] spacingBasePx: 4 allowedPx: [0, 1, 2] minLineHeight: 1.5 maxFiles: 200 ``` ## DSH APIs used - `ctx.skills.register()` — runtime skill (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill`) - `ctx.on('system-prompt/assemble', …)` — appends a runtime context entry after assembly, as `@deepseek-ai/dsh-working-directory` does - `ctx.workingDirectory.get(session)` — the session's working directory - `ctx.tools.register(defineTool(…))` — tool registration (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`) The lint only reads files inside the working directory; paths that resolve outside it are rejected. ## Development ```sh npm install npm run build npm test ``` `demo/` contains an A/B comparison; see `demo/RESULTS.md`. ## License MIT ## Credits The skill text was written from scratch; ideas were adapted from: - [anthropics/skills · frontend-design](https://github.com/anthropics/skills/tree/main/skills/frontend-design) (Apache-2.0): plan first, review the plan against generic defaults, spend boldness in one place, list of generated-page tells, screenshot self-critique. - [Viger1/dsh-design](https://github.com/Viger1/dsh-design) design-system skill (license not verified): fix palette and type scale first, one accent, spacing grid, hit area is not font size. - [SummerSec/SumSec-Skills · taste-skill](https://github.com/SummerSec/SumSec-Skills) (Apache-2.0): infer direction from the product, avoid the cream + brass "premium" default palette, hue-tinted shadows, one radius system. - [vercel-labs/web-interface-guidelines](https://github.com/vercel-labs/web-interface-guidelines): `:focus-visible`, no `transition: all`, `prefers-reduced-motion`, tabular numbers, 44px mobile targets. - [ChenYiming-aaa/dsh-ui-ux-pro-max](https://github.com/ChenYiming-aaa/dsh-ui-ux-pro-max) (MIT, data from nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill): prioritized checks (contrast, touch, no emoji icons).

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin for VA Studio: generate short dramas, images, videos, novels and screenplays, and reverse-engineer prompts.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-va-studio

把本地 **VA Studio** 后端接进 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）** 的第三方插件。装上之后，Agent 可以直接：

- 自动生成**短剧**（一句话 → 项目 + 分镜）
- 自动生成**图片**（文生图 / 图生图，1–4 张，可指定画幅与分辨率）
- 自动生成**视频**（单条 4–30 秒文生/图生视频；短剧项目一键成片）
- 自动生成**小说**（含章节/字数控制，生成后取完整正文）
- 自动生成**剧本**（从创意或已有小说改编）
- **提示词反推**（图片/视频 → 可直接使用的提示词、分镜、角色制作包）
- **提示词扩写**（几个词 → 完整生图/生视频提示词）

插件不内置模型，也不保存生成结果；它把 DSH 的 Agent 接到你已经配置好模型和素材库的 VA Studio 后端上。

## 前置条件

1. DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2`（`engines.dsh` 限定 `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0`）。
2. 一个可访问的 VA Studio 后端（默认 `http://127.0.0.1:8790`），且已登录账号有对应功能权限。
3. VA Studio 管理端已配置生成所需模型密钥（剧本需要 `screenplay` 功能权限）。

## 安装

### 从 GitHub 安装

```bash
"/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" \
  plugin --profile desktop add github:ygunoil/dsh-va-studio
```

也可以在 DSH 的 **Plugins → Add plugin** 里填 `github:ygunoil/dsh-va-studio`，或填 release 里的 `.tgz` 地址。

### 从本地 tarball 安装

> 推荐在 DSH 的 **Plugins** 页安装：侧边栏 Plugins → **Add plugin** → 输入本包的绝对路径（目录或 `.tgz`）→ 安装 → Enable now。

```bash
# 打包
cd /Users/mac/Desktop/xxt/dsh-va-studio
npm pack --cache /tmp/npm-cache-va-studio --pack-destination dist
# 得到 dist/dsh-va-studio-0.2.0.tgz
```

安装后如果界面没有立即出现新入口，按提示重启 Harness。配置入口有两个：**Settings → Plugins → VA Studio**，或 **Plugins → dsh-va-studio → Configure**。

### 配置连接

打开 **设置 → 插件 → VA Studio**：

| 字段 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 后端地址 | 例如 `http://127.0.0.1:8790`，不要带 `/api` 或结尾斜杠 |
| 登录方式 | 账号密码，或直接粘贴 VA Studio 的访问令牌 |
| 账号 / 密码 / 令牌 | 保存在本机 Host 的凭据存储中，不会进入对话、日志或提示词 |

点「保存并验证」会先调用后端健康检查，再验证登录；通过后配置才会落盘。

## 安装后可用的工具

| 工具 | 作用 | 成本提示 |
|---|---|---|
| `va_studio_status` | 后端健康、当前账号、功能权限、已配置模型 | 免费 |
| `va_studio_generate_novel` | 一句话 → 小说；返回完整 Markdown | 按章节计费，耗时随章节增长 |
| `va_studio_generate_screenplay` | 创意或小说 → 分集剧本；返回市场版全文 | 按集数计费，可能数分钟 |
| `va_studio_generate_drama` | 一句话剧情 → 短剧项目 + 分镜 | 按 LLM 调用计费，通常 1–10 分钟 |
| `va_studio_generate_image` | 文生图 / 图生图，1–4 张，9:16/16:9/1:1 等画幅 | 按张计费，通常十几秒到数分钟 |
| `va_studio_generate_video` | 单条 4–30 秒视频（文生/图生） | 按条计费，通常数分钟 |
| `va_studio_produce_video` | 短剧项目一键成片（定妆/关键帧/视频/配音/压片） | **最贵最慢**，必须用户明确同意后传 `confirm=true` |
| `va_studio_reverse_prompt` | 图片/视频 → 提示词、分镜、角色制作包 | 视频反推按次计费 |
| `va_studio_expand_prompt` | 短提示词 → 生产级提示词 | 很便宜 |
| `va_studio_job` | 继续等待/查询任意生成任务，完成后取回正文 | 免费 |

长任务采用 `wait_seconds` 预算：超时不会失败，而是返回 `jobId`，让 Agent 继续用 `va_studio_job` 轮询。

## 随包技能

| 技能 | 触发场景 |
|---|---|
| `va-studio` | 生成短剧/视频/小说/剧本，把一句话做成短剧 |
| `va-studio-reverse-prompt` | 提示词反推、看图写提示词、视频反推、扩写提示词 |

技能里写清了成本确认、输出归档、错误码处理和工作流顺序。

## 工作方式

```
DSH Agent
  ├─ 加载 va-studio 技能
  ├─ 调用 va_studio_generate_*（Host 半）
  │    ├─ ctx.credentials 取连接配置（密码/令牌只在 Host）
  │    ├─ POST /api/auth/login → 内存缓存 token（6 天）
  │    ├─ 提交异步任务 → 轮询 /api/drama/jobs/{id}
  │    └─ 取回正文/分镜/视频地址，经 render 返回给模型
  └─ 设置页（Client 半）读写 /api/va-studio.settings|save|test
```

- **凭据**：`ctx.credentials` 单条记录（`dsh-va-studio/connection`），只暴露 `configured/writable`，不回传明文。
- **本地上传**：只允许读当前会话工作区内的普通文件（图片 ≤20MB、视频 ≤120MB），防止把任意主机文件上传出去。
- **错误分类**：`AUTH` / `PERMISSION` / `INSUFFICIENT_POINTS` / `CONFLICT` / `VALIDATION` / `TIMEOUT` / `CONFIRM_REQUIRED` 等稳定错误码，技能里带处理建议。
- **不自动重试昂贵操作**：一键成片、出片类任务失败后不会自动重提。

## 验证状态

本版已在临时 DSH profile 中完成真实安装与启动验证（插件加载、client bundle 下发、设置端点存取、凭据持久化、9 个工具的注册与执行）。详细证据、复现命令与**未验证项**见仓库内的 `docs/verification.md`（开发文档不随 npm 包分发）。

## 开发与验证

```bash
# 依赖解析：本机跑测试时把 Harness 自带的 node_modules 链接进来（打包时不会带上）
# node /path/to/dsh-desktop/node_modules/.bin/asar extract \
#   "/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/app.asar" /tmp/dsh-asar
# ln -s /tmp/dsh-asar/dsh/node_modules node_modules

node --test test/*.test.mjs   # HTTP 客户端 / 错误映射
node --test test/settings.test.mjs    # 凭据记录 / 冲突 / 复用
node --test test/tools.test.mjs       # 10 个工具对 mock VA Studio 的端到端行为
node test/check-client.mjs            # client.js 加载协议与设置页注册
```

`test/mock-va-server.mjs` 是一个可独立运行的 VA Studio 模拟后端，用于离线测试全部工具，不会消耗真实额度。

## 已知边界

- 视频“方案生成”（文本/小说 → 多条视频方案）暂未做成独立工具，当前视频能力是单条片段与短剧项目成片。
- 视频反推使用同步接口：超长视频请先剪短或降低 `max_frames`；异步反推会额外生成角色身份板/故事板图并产生额外成本，本插件暂不调用。
- 生成任务在 VA Studio 服务端继续执行，插件超时或取消不会取消服务端任务；可用 `jobId` 回 VA Studio 任务中心查看。
- 需要登录的媒体文件（项目内文件、成片下载）在浏览器里打开时使用 VA Studio 自己的登录态。

## 目录

```
dsh-va-studio/
├── package.json          # DSH 插件清单（bundle patch / client / engines.dsh）
├── cordis.patch.yml      # 把 Host 半插入 profile 插件树
├── dsh/index.js          # Host 半入口：配置端点、工具、技能、系统提示
├── client/client.js      # Client 半：Settings → Plugins 设置页
├── lib/                  # 凭据、VA Studio HTTP 客户端、工具实现、工作区文件读取
├── skills/               # 随包技能（va-studio、va-studio-reverse-prompt）
├── test/                 # 单元/集成测试 + mock 后端 + client 协议校验
└── docs/                 # 本插件开发期的 API 映射与 DSH 插件指南
```
